title: Prime Muse 1.2 · Unity
summary: Unity attempt driven through Unity MCP: wing-tracked flight controller, a procedurally built world, NPC birds with growth and a HUD. The world is set up by an editor script.

logs.note: No agent logs were kept for this run.

apk.note: Built by the lab on 9 Oct 2026 from the archived project, upgraded to Unity 6000.6.4f1 and with the one-file fix its scene needs to load. Not tested on a headset.
apk.label: Soaring

notes: As archived, its scene does not load in a Unity 6000.6.4f1 player: a component declared inside another script's file (Perch, in WorldBuilder.cs) was saved into the scene 590 times. The lab's recordings and APK use a copy with that one class moved to its own file. It was made in Unity 6000.5.7f1, which is not installed here, so the copy was upgraded.
